analysis.bulk_window: receiver seconds [10,duration-1); discard first 10 s and final bin
analysis.claim_scope: This frozen synthetic workload and local kernel, not all Internet paths
analysis.collapse_validity: A must trigger at least 1000 collapsed segments; otherwise pair fails gate
analysis.collapse_window: entire 40 s, two 5 s fast / 15 s slow cycles
analysis.confidence_bound: Minimum ratio for greater claims; maximum ratio for less claims
analysis.failure_policy: A run failure stops the experiment; resume only missing runs, retain existing results.
analysis.probe_failure_policy: Any failed remote probe inside measurement window fails latency gate
analysis.probe_window: same receiver-time window; align process monotonic timestamps
analysis.stopping: Exactly eight blocks. No replacement of valid unfavorable runs; no post-hoc sample increase.
analysis.test: Exact one-sided paired sign test against the practical ratio threshold

profiles.32-on:
# Enable forwarding first because toggling ip_forward resets IPv4 sysctls.
net.ipv4.ip_forward = 1

# https://blog.cloudflare.com/optimizing-tcp-for-high-throughput-and-low-latency
net.ipv4.tcp_rmem = 8192 262144 33554432
net.ipv4.tcp_wmem = 4096 16384 33554432
net.ipv4.tcp_adv_win_scale = -2
net.ipv4.tcp_collapse_max_bytes = 6291456
net.ipv4.tcp_notsent_lowat = 131072

# Connection handling for relay and egress servers
net.core.somaxconn = 4096
net.core.netdev_max_backlog = 16384
net.ipv4.tcp_max_syn_backlog = 8192
net.ipv4.ip_local_port_range = 10240 65535
net.ipv4.tcp_fin_timeout = 15
net.ipv4.tcp_fastopen = 3
net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing = 1
net.ipv4.tcp_slow_start_after_idle = 0
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_time = 600
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_intvl = 60
net.ipv4.tcp_keepalive_probes = 3
net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies = 1

# BBR+fq
net.ipv4.tcp_congestion_control = bbr
net.core.default_qdisc = fq

# ECN: accept it on incoming connections without requesting it on outbound SYNs.
net.ipv4.tcp_ecn = 2

# TCP window scaling, as per RFC1323
net.ipv4.tcp_window_scaling = 1
